changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingcharge AS SELECT bc.id, bc.charge_number, bc.patient_id, bc.encounter_id, bc.charge_type, bc.currency, bc.gross_amount, bc.discount_amount, bc.exemption_amount, bc.tax_amount, bc.net_amount, bc.allocated_amount, bc.outstanding_amount, bc.line_count, bc.status, bc.charge_date, bc.confirmed_date, bc.closed_date, bc.cancelled_date, bc.cancelled_by, bc.cancellation_reason, bc.reversed_charge_id, bc.idempotency_key, bc.source_type, bc.source_id, bc.source_reference, bc.notes, bc.created_by, bc.created_date, bc.last_modified_by, bc.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_charge bc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingcharge TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingcharge FROM report_user;
